event_name: Document 46 Date 23 October 2022 Time 15:47 2022 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 20 - 23 October 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 10 failed to properly serve a penalty.
offence: Breach of Article 54.4 c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and determined that Car 10 came into the pit lane and stopped. The front wheels were lifted at 4.54 seconds and rear wheels at 4.8 seconds. This is a breach of the regulations, however not significant enough to warrant disqualification. As this was a team error, no driver penalty points are allocated.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 10 Failure To Serve A Penalty
